purpose: REQ-CFG-01 execution-environment identification evidence, gathered ahead of implementation-order step 10 (freeze + principal verification run). Recording these values does not itself constitute a freeze: docker-compose.yml, prototype_stack/compose.yaml, the root Dockerfile, and .github/workflows/ci.yml deliberately keep floating tags (mysql:latest, php:8.4-apache, node:22-alpine, composer:2, and the two Selenium images) for development convenience, per docs/DEVELOPMENT_DOCUMENTATION.md §10.1's MySQL decision record and the parallel rationale for the others. At freeze (step 10), the project owner decides whether to pin these floating tags in the compose/Dockerfile/CI files themselves to the exact versions/digests recorded here, or to re-resolve and re-record fresh values at that time - this manifest is evidence for that decision, not the decision itself.
observed_from: docker buildx imagetools inspect <tag> against the live registry for each manifest-list digest, plus running the resolved image to read its own version string directly (not assumed from the tag name)

mysql:latest.role: db service - docker-compose.yml, prototype_stack/compose.yaml, .github/workflows/ci.yml (backend-integration job's services.mysql)

php:8.4-apache.role: Dockerfile `base` stage - the actual base of both the `dev` and `runtime` published images

node:22-alpine.role: Dockerfile `frontend-build` stage - build-time only, not present in any published image (§10.8's --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM pin applies to this stage)

composer:2.role: Dockerfile `vendor`/`vendor-dev` stages - build-time only, not present in any published image (also --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM pinned, §10.8)

selenium/standalone-chrome:latest.role: test tooling only, never part of the deployed application (IMPLEMENTATION_SPECIFICATION.md §8's own framing). Used by .github/workflows/ci.yml's e2e job (amd64 GitHub-hosted runners) and as app/tests/E2E/docker-compose.yml's SELENIUM_IMAGE override on amd64 hosts
selenium/standalone-chrome:latest.resolved_version: 24.04 (selenium-docker project's own release tag; the bundled Chrome build floats within it by that project's design, not this one's)

seleniarm/standalone-chromium:latest.role: test tooling only, never part of the deployed application. docker-compose.yml's and app/tests/E2E/docker-compose.yml's default SELENIUM_IMAGE, for local Apple Silicon/arm64 development (§10.5's arm64 rationale)
seleniarm/standalone-chromium:latest.resolved_version: not labeled by the image itself; identified only by the digest below

deliberately_not_recorded.project_owned_ghcr_images: ghcr.io/junomarx/bsc-thesis-icd10:latest, :dev, and bsc-thesis-icd10-bootstrap:latest are built from this repository's own source, not a third-party dependency - their identity is the git commit they were built from (docs/CHANGELOG.md's CI entries already record specific confirmed-live commits/run IDs), not a version to pin here.
